title: 1993 Russia 500 Rubles Banknote P-256 Russian Federation Paper Money Circulated
descriptionText:
Condition:
Circulated

Item Specifics:

* Country: Russia
* Country/Region of Manufacture: Russian Federation
* Year: 1993
* Denomination: 500 Rubles
* Type: Banknote
* Pick Number: P-256
* Circulated/Uncirculated: Circulated
* Grade: Ungraded
* Certification: Uncertified
* Serial Number: СЛ 4373367

Description:
Original 1993 Russian Federation 500 Rubles banknote issued by the Bank of Russia.

The note features Kremlin imagery and the Russian tricolor on the front, with the 1993 date clearly visible on the reverse. Serial number СЛ 4373367.

This is a circulated example with noticeable age and handling wear. There are creases, edge and corner wear, discoloration/soiling, and other signs of circulation. No grading or professional authentication has been performed.

Please review all photos carefully for the exact condition. The banknote pictured is the exact note you will receive.

A nice inexpensive addition to a Russian, Soviet-era transition, or world paper money collection.
